snippet.title: Gate Guard Simulator Musical Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Gate Guard Simulator is a wonderfully-silly game where you man the gates of a medieval town to decide who makes it inside — and who ends up in the stocks. A new sing-song gameplay trailer revealed the kind of quirky punters (and cheeky geese) you can expect to deal with when you're saddled with the titular role. Gate Guard Simulator is coming soon to PC, but you can wishlist it now on Steam.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111570/Gate_Guard_Simulator/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
